representation.centered_contrast: raw contrast after subtracting each stock/EV per-channel patch mean
representation.pairwise_direction: cosine across all 288x3 aligned contrast components

stop_rules: This is a retrospective failure-mechanism diagnostic over the already consumed SF3.A3H cohort, not a fresh confirmation or operator result.
No post-result change to coordinates, centering, pairwise metrics, floors or thresholds.
Failure requires independent roll/process/scanner and exposure-controlled observations; it must not be rescued by a larger operator, K>1 or routing on this cohort.
Pass may justify only a separately frozen independent-source confirmation; it does not reopen the failed SF3.A3I operator family.
claim_ceiling: retrospective one-setup IT8 diagnosis of whether the Portra 400 versus Ektar 100 scanner-space contrast is directionally stable across four exposures; not an operator, Velvia evidence, natural-scene transfer, independent roll/process/scanner evidence, calibrated stock response or product promotion
